title: Split Panel
description: Two panes and a handle — drag it, or tab to it and use the arrow keys.
a11y: The handle is a focusable role=separator that controls the first pane, with aria-valuenow, aria-valuemin and aria-valuemax (default 20–80). Left/Right move it in the arrow's visual direction (RTL included); stacked panes use Up/Down. Shift moves 10 instead of 2, and Home/End jump to the limits. Dragging uses pointer capture and reports one change when it ends. Screen-reader output is not yet verified by hand.
